theorems.name: Submission.dimred_tr_bc_ct_weight_convergence
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (x : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (R : IMRep U n), R.Represents T → ∃ R' : IMRep (dilation x lam '' U) n, R'.Represents (blowUp T x lam hlam.ne') ∧ ∀ s : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet s → R'.measure s = ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ n) * R.measure (dilation x lam ⁻¹' s)) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (V : Set (Euclid P)) (A : GeometricCurrentOn V n) (R : IMRep V n) (a : Euclid P) (ss : ℕ → ℝ) (hss : ∀ j, 0 < ss j) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (RC : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), R.Represents A → RC.Represents C → MassMeasuresConverge (fun j => blowUp A a (ss j) (hss j).ne') C → ∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x, f x ∂(ENNReal.ofReal ((ss j)⁻¹ ^ n) • R.measure.map (dilation a (ss j)))) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, f x ∂RC.measure))
